summary: Your Complete Blood Count (CBC) report shows that your red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets are all within the laboratory's printed normal reference ranges.

biomarkers.name: Hemoglobin
biomarkers.explanation: Hemoglobin is the protein in your red blood cells that carries oxygen from your lungs to the rest of your body.

biomarkers.name: WBC Count
biomarkers.explanation: White blood cells are an important part of your immune system that help defend your body against infections.

biomarkers.name: Platelets
biomarkers.explanation: Platelets are tiny cell fragments that help your blood clot normally to stop bleeding when you have an injury.
